verdict.rationale: Vanta ships a Trust Center that automates security reviews (vanta-docs-19), and the platform continuously monitors controls and collects evidence (vanta-docs-45, vanta-docs-49). It also auto-discovers vendors (vanta-docs-13), but no evidence says any of this data flows into the Trust Center automatically. missing for 10: evidence that Trust Center control status syncs live from platform monitoring, auto-updating subprocessor lists, automatic document renewal or expiry handling on the Trust Center, independent or hands-on corroboration.
